name: Marina Bay Street Circuit
summary: F1's first night race: hot, humid and bumpy, and close to two hours long.
character: Slow street corners, heat and humidity make it one of the toughest races on drivers' bodies. Races often run close to the two-hour limit, and safety cars are common. A 2023 change took out four corners.

layouts.name: Current layout
factNotes: Elevation change: 5.3 m, checked by F1nsight. f1-circuits.com lists 0 m.
Length: 4.927 km per Formula 1. f1-circuits.com, PlanetF1 and Formula One History list 4.940 km.

corners.name: Turn 1
corners.note: Hard braking at the end of the pit straight. The best place to pass.

corners.name: Turn 7
corners.note: The end of Raffles Boulevard. The other overtaking spot, and a tight one to get right.

corners.name: The Padang section
corners.note: Runs alongside the Padang playing field, past some of the city's oldest buildings.

moments.title: Crashgate
moments.body: Nelson Piquet Jr. crashed on purpose to bring out a safety car that set up Fernando Alonso's win. It came out a year later, and team boss Flavio Briatore was banned (a court later overturned the ban).

history.body: First race, and F1's first night race.
Layout shortened from 23 to 19 corners, now 4.940 km.
